reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.
The cited Client covenants (§ 8 a–e) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching obligation, so the document matches the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here: they test the fallback wording of a non-solicit clause that does not exist in the agreement.
Rationale is accurate and correctly notes the absence benefits us and should not be volunteered; the fallback terms are stated only as a negotiation reserve, not as a proposed edit.
